spec: MLB Today's Games card-bit run-engine date-drift audit + fix
head: 15559cd

verdict.summary: The card path is already family-aware and already degrades honestly for the pure drift case (board date exists, run_engine_markets missing or older -> muted 'unavailable', never wrong-date prices, never a crash). The ONE guardrail-3 gap: when a game is priced from a NEWER artifact than the board date (the deliberate 145d841 / GMT-rollover cross-artifact convention), the strip rendered cross-date prices with NO visible date label. Fixed by stamping the source artifact date onto each resolved slate row and rendering a muted 'prices from <date> run' notice whenever it differs from the board date. Aligned-date output is byte-identical (no notice).
verdict.guardrail_3_status: CLOSED — a run-engine quote can never render on a board whose date differs from the pricing artifact without a visible date notice.

step0_ground_truth.a_date_resolution: todays_games.main() resolves the slate date from utils.valid_dates (todays_games_*.csv names, remote contents API + local glob; calibration daily[] + prediction-history game_dates merged in available_dates). The selected date reaches the card loop as date_str.
step0_ground_truth.b_artifact_and_columns: Run-engine card bits come from run_engine_markets_<date>.csv slate rows (kind=='slate') joined by game_id == game_pk (the 145d841 convention). market_diagnostics.resolve_slate_across_artifacts maps {game_id: slate_record}; run_engine_card_bits reads home/away_expected_runs, p_*_<line> grid columns, RUN_COVER_COL, derived-ML.
step0_ground_truth.c_miss_behavior: load_run_engine_markets returns an EMPTY frame (with a loud log line) when the artifact is missing; _slate_rows skips empty/no-kind frames; an unresolvable id is simply absent from the map. _runengine_html(None) renders the muted 'Run Engine data currently unavailable' notice inside the intact fb-runengine container — never a crash, never a silent omission. Confirmed at source + tests.

d_date_state_combinations.behavior: prices from Y (artifact_date == board -> no notice)
frame set = {Y: empty} + {d >= Y} none -> no slate rows -> honest 'unavailable'. NO wrong-date prices
frames include the newer artifact; games matched by game_pk / GMT-rollover matchup resolve from it (fresher, same game). NOW carries the visible 'prices from <date> run' notice

d_date_state_combinations.markets: only older than Y (no Y, no newer)
d_date_state_combinations.behavior: older artifacts are EXCLUDED by the d >= date_str filter -> 'unavailable'. Stale quotes are impossible by construction

date never selected -> nothing renders (available_dates needs todays_games_* / calibration daily / prediction-history). Markets for a pruned board's date are pruned by the 15559cd board-backed rule in the same cleanup run

step0_ground_truth.retention_policy_interaction: 15559cd: todays_games_* / shap_game_* prune at 3 days; run_engine_markets_* / run_engine_oof_* / predictions_history_* are board-backed (kept while the board is tracked). So a navigable board Y always has its run-engine data IF it was ever shipped; a partial-failure run (board shipped, markets not) triggers the honest unavailable fallback, and markets-newer-than-board occurs naturally across the GMT rollover (a later run re-prices the same evening games) — the exact case now date-labeled.

step1_verdict: Real-but-narrow: the drift case was already honest; the cross-date-pricing-without-label case was not. Fix implemented rather than record-only because guardrail 3 makes wrong-date-without-notice unacceptable and the 145d841 convention legitimately produces cross-date quotes.

market_diagnostics.py: resolve_slate_across_artifacts: each resolved slate record is now tagged {**row, 'artifact_date': <winning frame date>} in every precedence branch (a/b/c) — additive; the frame's row dicts are never mutated.
run_engine_card_bits: bits carries 'artifact_date' from the row (None for pre-tagging callers -> no notice; byte-identical behavior).
todays_games.py: _runengine_html(bits, home, away, board_date=None): when bits.artifact_date and board_date differ, renders '(prices from YYYY-MM-DD run)' right after the RUN ENGINE label; same-date or None -> exactly nothing.
_card_html(g, re_bits, board_date=None) threads board_date through to the strip.
main() card loop passes board_date=date_str, so the live board path gets the label.
step2_fix.design_choice: Family-aware pick was already the pattern here (todays_games._run_engine_dates predates the 827de1b shared utils helper and enumerates markets-only for the card). The new notice is the minimal change that satisfies guardrail 3 without duplicating or reworking the resolver. Consolidating todays_games._run_engine_dates onto utils._family_dated_dates is a clean follow-up, deliberately NOT done here (no behavior change needed; guardrail-1 'no speculative rewrites').

test_market_diagnostics.py: test_present_row_is_the_raw_slate_record: repurposed for the additive tag — original fields preserved AND artifact_date == exact-date file (mechanical schema addition, comment updated; no assertion weakened).
test_frontend_todays_games.py: DRIFT CASE: board 09-04, markets stop at 09-03 -> frames {09-04: empty} -> {} -> strip renders 'currently unavailable', no 'Proj:', no crash.
ALIGNED: same-date render == board_date=None render byte-for-byte; no notice.
STALE-MISLABEL GUARD: GMT-rollover resolve (artifact_date 09-30 on board 09-29) -> strip contains '(prices from 2026-08-30 run)'; legacy no-board_date call stays notice-free.
LIVE/empty-local: resolve({}) -> {} -> unavailable notice, no exception.
_card_html threading: same-date no notice; board one day behind -> notice present on the full card HTML.
step3_tests.acceptance: Full MLB backend+frontend suite: 1278 tests, 0 failures / 0 errors, 21 skips (pre-change baseline 1268/0/21 — +10 collected, +5 new card tests all green). First full-suite run after the change reported FAILED(1,1) with a weather-API 429/503 retry storm visible in the log; the identical code passed cleanly on the immediate re-run (transient network flake, not a logic failure).

judgment_calls: The card was NOT rewritten to a markets-page-style family-aware pick — it already had one; the record documents that finding rather than speculating a rewrite (guardrail 1).

The '/prices from <date> run/' label is the chosen honest presentation (compact, muted, re-na-styled like the run-ML caption) — alternative (omit the box) was rejected because the 145d841 convention intentionally serves fresher same-game prices and a label keeps them useful.
Market_diagnostics.py and todays_games.py are FRONTEND files (repo-root frontend/), which is the task's allowed edit scope; no backend engine/pricing/feature/schema file was touched.
